name: tong-humanize
title_zh: AI稿先过这关再发：主编级去味终审
tagline_zh: 写完的公众号/小红书一股AI味？它逐句扫掉空话套话，顺手做事实核查、砍掉强行升华，最后一道质量门禁不过就不放行。
tagline_en: AI-flavored draft? It line-edits out boilerplate, fact-checks, cuts forced grand narratives, and gatekeeps until.
desc_en: Scan and edit Chinese articles for authentic human voice, cut AI boilerplate, and perform chief editor review: fact check, cut forced grand narratives, and enforce quality gate. Use when the user asks 写文章, 写一篇, 公众号文章, 小红书文案, 写速览, 写简报, 去AI味, 润色, 像人话, 主编审稿, 终审剪枝, 质量门禁, humanize, or tong-humanize.
why_zh: 不是换个词就算润色。它按主编终审的流程走：先扫AI腔，再查事实硬伤。
why_en: Not a synonym swap. It runs a real chief-editor sequence: strip AI tics, verify facts, kill forced uplift—three gates before.
limit_zh: 只处理中文文本，且需要原文有明确事实可查（纯抒情散文查不了）。它改的是表达和结构，不替你补数据、不重写内容。
limit_en: Chinese text only; needs checkable facts (no pure lyric prose). It edits expression/structure, won't add data or rewrite content. Over 3000 chars.
title_en: Chief-editor pass that strips AI boilerplate
